findings.title: Styler captures record pointer, may become stale
findings.message: The styler closes over the record pointer r and reads r.node and r.theme at style time. If the record is reused or updated on re-render, these fields may be stale or mutated concurrently with the styler. The test posts changes and relies on the record being updated in place; if records are replaced rather than mutated, the toggle would keep the old color.
findings.suggestion: Confirm records are updated in place on invalidate; otherwise resolve the color from the widget's current record (look it up at style time) rather than a captured pointer.

findings.title: Repeated style resolution and swallowed error
findings.message: ResolveStyle runs the full style resolution on every style pass for each of three icons per toggle, and errors are silently swallowed, hiding theme misconfiguration (for example an unknown role).
findings.suggestion: Resolve once per toggle per update and cache it, and surface or log the error rather than ignoring it.
